queries:
WITH race_avg AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_wins
  FROM driverStandings ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country
),
country_avg AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(race_wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM race_avg
  GROUP BY country
),
bench AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS b FROM country_avg
),
kept AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins
  FROM country_avg ca, bench
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > bench.b
),
second AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS m FROM kept
)
SELECT k.country,
       k.avg_wins AS avg_wins,
       k.avg_wins - bench.b AS above_benchmark,
       k.avg_wins - second.m AS above_second_mean
FROM kept k, bench, second
WHERE k.avg_wins > second.m;
WITH race_avg AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_avg
  FROM driverStandings ds
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM results res
    WHERE res.raceId = ds.raceId AND res.driverId = ds.driverId
  )
  GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country
),
country_avg AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(race_avg) AS avg_wins
  FROM race_avg
  GROUP BY country
),
bench AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS b FROM country_avg
),
kept AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins
  FROM country_avg ca, bench
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > bench.b
),
second AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS m FROM kept
)
SELECT k.country,
       k.avg_wins,
       k.avg_wins - bench.b AS above_benchmark,
       k.avg_wins - second.m AS above_second_mean
FROM kept k, bench, second
WHERE k.avg_wins > second.m;
WITH race_avg AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) AS race_avg_wins
  FROM driverStandings ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE ds.wins IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.raceId, c.country
),
country_avg AS (
  SELECT country, AVG(race_avg_wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM race_avg
  GROUP BY country
),
bench AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS m1 FROM country_avg
),
kept AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins
  FROM country_avg ca, bench b
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > b.m1
),
m2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS m2 FROM kept
)
SELECT k.country,
       k.avg_wins,
       k.avg_wins - b.m1 AS above_benchmark,
       k.avg_wins - m2.m2 AS above_second_mean
FROM kept k, bench b, m2
WHERE k.avg_wins > m2.m2;
WITH race_avg AS (

  FROM driverStandings ds
  JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE ds.wins IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.country, r.raceId
),
country_avg AS (

),
bench AS (

kept AS (

second AS (

SELECT k.country, k.avg_wins,

       k.avg_wins - second.b2 AS above_second_mean
